info.title: UCI Anteater API - course search
info.description: Public UC Irvine course data: catalogue, live schedule of classes (WebSoc), historical grade distributions, enrollment history and degree requirements. Provided by Anteater API (ICSSC Projects). Unofficial - always tell the student to confirm on WebReg before registering.

get.description: Search UCI's schedule of classes for one term. Returns sections nested as schools > departments > courses > sections, each with meeting times, instructor, enrolled/capacity, waitlist and final exam. ALWAYS pass at least one narrowing filter besides year/quarter (department, courseNumber, ge, instructorName or sectionCodes) - a bare term returns tens of thousands of sections and will be truncated.

parameters.description: Four-digit year, e.g. "2026".

parameters.description: ge
